'''Uroš Slokar''' ({{IPA|sl|ˈurɔʃ ˈslokar|Slovenian pronunciation:}}; born 14 May 1983) is a Slovenian former professional [[basketball]] player who last played for [[Pallacanestro Cantù]] of the [[Lega Basket Serie A]].

==Professional career==
After playing two seasons in the [[Premier A Slovenian Basketball League|Slovenian basketball league]], Slokar moved to Italy's [[Serie A (basketball)|Serie A]] in 2003, where he represented [[Pallacanestro Treviso|Benetton Treviso]] and [[Pallalcesto Amatori Udine]]. Upon his [[2005 NBA draft]] selection by the [[Toronto Raptors]] (58th overall), he remained a further season in Europe. In his [[2006-07 NBA season|2006-2007 NBA season]] the Raptors won a first ever [[Atlantic Division (NBA)|Atlantic Division]] title.

On 16 August 2007 Slokar signed a one-year deal with [[Triumph Lyubertsy]], formerly known as Dynamo Moscow Region, which plays in the [[Russian Basketball Super League|Russian Super League]] and the European [[ULEB Cup|Eurocup]]. After one season in Russia, he returned to Italy and signed with [[Fortitudo Bologna]] for the next two years.

For the 2009–10 season he returned to Slovenia, where he played for [[KK Union Olimpija|Union Olimpija]]. He later left the club for [[Montepaschi Siena]].

In October 2010 he signed with the [[Liga ACB|Spanish League]] club [[Assignia Manresa]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.thehoopsmarket.com/news/assignia-manresa-lands-uros-slokar.aspx |title=Assignia Manresa lands Uros Slokar |access-date=2010-10-15 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120310232010/http://www.thehoopsmarket.com/news/assignia-manresa-lands-uros-slokar.aspx |archive-date=2012-03-10 |url-status=usurped }}</ref>

In August 2011, he signed with [[Pallacanestro Virtus Roma|Lottomatica Roma]].<ref>[http://www.sportando.net/eng/italy/serie-a/30114/virtus_roma_officially_announces_clay_tucker_and_uros_slokar.html Virtus Roma officially announces Clay Tucker and Uros Slokar]</ref> One year later, in July 2012, he came back to Spain to play with [[CB Gran Canaria]].<ref>[http://www.acb.com/redaccion.php?id=86149 Uros Slokar, versatilidad y anotación para el Gran Canaria 2014] ACB.com</ref> On 31 October 2013 he signed a six-week contract with [[Alba Berlin]].<ref>{{cite web|title=ALBA BERLIN adds Slokar on short-term deal|url=http://www.eurocupbasketball.com/eurocup/home/transactions/eurocup-2013-14/i/121846|publisher=Eurocupbasketball.com|access-date=7 November 2013|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20131103150928/http://www.eurocupbasketball.com/eurocup/home/transactions/eurocup-2013-14/i/121846|archive-date=3 November 2013}}</ref>

On 16 December 2013 he signed a two-month deal with [[CB Estudiantes]].<ref>{{cite news|title=El internacional esloveno Uros Slokar refuerza la pintura de Tuenti Móvil Estudiantes|url=http://www.clubestudiantes.com/frontend/clubestudiantes/noticia.php?id_noticia=10587&id_seccion=428|access-date=16 December 2013|language=es|newspaper=Clubestudiantes.com}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|title=Estudiantes announced Uros Slokar|url=http://www.sportando.net/eng/europe/spain/69732/estudiantes-announced-uros-slokar.html|access-date=16 December 2013|newspaper=Sportando.net}}</ref> On 18 February 2014 he was re-signed for the rest of the season.<ref>[http://www.sportando.com/en/europe/spain/111678/estudiantes-keep-uros-slokar-for-the-season.html Estudiantes keep Uros Slokar for the season]</ref> On 29 October 2014 he again re-signed with Estudiantes.<ref>[http://www.sportando.com/en/europe/spain/139363/estudiantes-lands-uros-slokar.html Estudiantes lands Uros Slokar]</ref>

On 28 August 2015 he signed with [[CB Sevilla|Baloncesto Sevilla]],<ref>[http://www.sportando.com/en/europe/spain/174124/sevilla-officially-signs-uros-slokar.html Sevilla officially signs Uros Slokar]</ref> ending his contract with the Andalusian club on 19 January 2016.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.acb.com/redaccion.php?id=119474|publisher=ACB.com|date=19 January 2016|access-date=20 January 2016|language=es|title=Anderson y Slokar no continuarán en el Baloncesto Sevilla}}</ref>

On 28 February 2016 Slokar signed with Serie A team [[Juvecaserta Basket]] for the rest of the season.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.juvecaserta.it/firmato-uros-slokar/|publisher=juvecaserta.it|date=29 February 2016|access-date=29 February 2016|language=it|title=Firmato Uros Slokar|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160303112003/http://www.juvecaserta.it/firmato-uros-slokar/|archive-date=3 March 2016|url-status=dead|df=dmy-all}}</ref>

On 29 December 2016 Slokar signed with [[Pallacanestro Cantù]] for the remainder of the season.<ref>{{cite news|title=Pallacanestro Cantù signs Uros Slokar for remainder of season|url=http://www.sportando.com/en/italy/serie-a/221670/pallacanestro-cantu-signs-uros-slokar-for-remainder-of-season.html|access-date=29 December 2016|publisher=Sportando.com|date=29 December 2016}}</ref>

==National team career==
[[File:Slovenia - Croatia at Eurobasket 2009 4.jpg|thumb|Slokar (#4) at [[EuroBasket 2009]]]]
Internationally, Slokar has played with [[Slovenia national basketball team|Slovenia]] at the 1999 [[FIBA Europe Under-16 Championship]], the 2000 [[FIBA Europe Under-18 Championship]], the 2002 [[FIBA Europe Under-20 Championship]], the [[EuroBasket 2005|2005 FIBA European Championship]], the [[EuroBasket 2007|2007 FIBA European Championship]], the [[EuroBasket 2009|2009 FIBA European Championship]], the [[EuroBasket 2011|2011 FIBA European Championship]], the [[EuroBasket 2013|2013 FIBA European Championship]], the [[EuroBasket 2015|2015 FIBA European Championship]], the [[FIBA World Olympic Qualifying Tournament for Men 2008]], the [[2006 FIBA World Championship]], the [[2010 FIBA World Championship]] and the [[2014 FIBA World Championship]].
